# RoboCasa-Shift

RoboCasa-Shift: Stage-Aware Robustness Evaluation of Vision-Language-Action Policies in Long-Horizon Household Manipulation

**2026-10-20 · Preprint · Fudan University**

**[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27861)** · [Code](https://github.com/HaochengWang23/RoboCasa-Shift) · [Data](https://huggingface.co/datasets/HaochengWang23/robocasa-shift)

Matched clean/perturbed rollouts and audited simulator-state stages diagnose VLA robustness on clean-qualified long-horizon tasks.

<img src="../../../website/public/images/catalog/robocasa-shift-benchmark.webp" width="760" alt="Fig. 1: Overview of RoboCasa-Shift. **Task names — Complete four-task formal suite. Each task uses 20 fixed base episodes and 13 conditions (clean plus four factors×three severities).:**

- PreSoakPan
- RinseSinkBasin
- StackBowlsCabinet
- WashLettuce

**Scope and qualifications**

- Formal perturbation evaluation covers only GR00T N1.5 and four qualified tasks; other screened policies did not pass the clean-competence gate.
- Stage predicates are audited simulator diagnostics, not official ground-truth temporal annotations.
- Equal severity indices across perturbation factors do not imply equivalent physical changes.
